error_direction_rationale: Numerators are taken over-inclusive on purpose (the cash-and-interest-bearing figure stands in for pure cash on the long-form and 25% profiles; total debt stands in for interest-based debt), every pinned exclusion is implemented as fail-iff-exceeds with equality compliant exactly as each printed threshold reads, and contradictory or out-of-declared-domain inputs refuse instead of defaulting. The node can therefore exclude a company a hand reviewer would pass; it cannot wave a violating company through a declared row. The one deliberate exception is the omitted verdict branches below (unrepresented_known rows), each of which errs the other way and says so.

branches.branch: Total debt, cash plus interest-bearing securities, and receivables plus cash, each against total assets at 3333 bp; a current constituent is screened on this set.
A security that is not a current constituent is screened on the lower 3000 bp set and the entry flag fires.
The average-cap profile screens against the mean of the last 36 month-end observations, fewer if fewer are supplied, reported floored to the minor unit while the verdict uses the exact mean.
The receivables-plus-cash row is widened to 4900 bp retention / 4600 bp entry on the average-cap profile only.
Cumulative revenue from prohibited activities at 500 bp of total revenue.
Conventional debt and cash plus short-term interest-bearing securities each at 3300 bp of the average daily cap over the supplied window.
When the exact average daily cap falls below the total asset value, the asset value replaces it as the denominator and the switch is flagged.
Interest income plus non-compliant-activity income at 500 bp of total income.
Interest-based debt represented by total debt at 2500 bp of total assets.
Interest income plus the 750 bp imputed return on interest-based investments at 300 bp of total income, cross-multiplied exactly in BigInt.
Receivables plus cash and bank balances at 9000 bp of total assets.

Compliant debt is subtracted from the total-debt numerator for the eleven pinned country codes only, only when it actually removes something, and the subtraction is flagged; it applies to both profiles of the same family.
Per-dividend purification share floor(dividend x (prohibited + interest income) / total income) with the residual named so purified + residual/denominator reconstructs the exact share.
Pro-rata interest income purification floor(dividend x interest income / total income) with named residual.
The daily-average profile pins no dividend purification rule; when a dividend is supplied the leg stays null and the not-pinned flag fires rather than borrowing another profile rule.
Every payload, refusal or not, carries not_a_shariah_ruling true: arithmetic and verdict rows only, never an opinion, certification or ruling.
Compliance flags are mirrored into output_payload.warnings so the payload is self-describing without the envelope.
A methodology key outside the four pinned authorities refuses, naming the received value and the supported set.
A field an authority profile requires is absent: refusal naming the field, never a default.
A declared amount arriving as a non-integer type refuses rather than coercing.
Negative amounts or amounts above the declared 1e15 minor-unit bound refuse.
Null, array or primitive policy_parameters refuse with the wrong-type code.

branches.clause: node input contract (1e13 series-element bound, 600-element cap)
branches.branch: A market-cap element above the declared element bound, or a series longer than 600 elements, refuses.
A compliant-debt figure larger than the total-debt figure refuses rather than producing a negative numerator.
Prohibited plus interest income above total income makes the purification factor undefined; the purification leg refuses with its own flag and a null row while screening verdicts stand.

branches.clause: IPR definition (pro-rata share above the dividend)
branches.branch: Interest income above total income makes the pro-rata purification share exceed the whole dividend; the leg refuses with its own flag and a null row while screening verdicts stand.
The composition, granularity and completeness of the supplied market-cap window: the node averages exactly what it is given.

assumption_of_use.source: the pinned screening text defines a 24-month average daily market cap; the node never sees the calendar
assumption_of_use.owner: the CALLER supplies a window that faithfully represents the pinned averaging period; month-end data under this profile is announced by flag

branches.branch: Month alignment and completeness of the month-end series; a missing month silently shortens the mean.

assumption_of_use.source: the pinned fn9 definition of the average issuer market cap
assumption_of_use.owner: the CALLER, who owns supplying contiguous month-end observations; the node cannot detect a gap

branches.branch: That total debt equals or over-covers interest-based debt: the kernel screens total debt as the proxy.

assumption_of_use.source: the pinned 25% rule is written on interest-based debt specifically
assumption_of_use.owner: the CALLER, who may over-screen (conservative) but can never under-screen by this substitution

branches.branch: That interest income and non-compliant-activity income are disjoint, non-overlapping components of total income.

assumption_of_use.source: the pinned NPI definition sums the two components
assumption_of_use.owner: the CALLER, who owns that the two figures do not double-count; over-counting errs toward exclusion (conservative)

branches.branch: That the income figures reflect the current quarterly factor vintage; the node stamps methodology_as_of but cannot date the caller income data.

assumption_of_use.source: the pinned s2.3 quarterly update cadence
assumption_of_use.owner: the CALLER, who owns supplying figures of the current vintage

branches.branch: That every *_minor amount is denominated in ONE currency minor unit; ratios are currency-invariant only under that assumption.

assumption_of_use.source: the node contract declares integer minor units
assumption_of_use.owner: the CALLER, who owns the currency and its minor-unit exponent; a mixed-currency input is a valid number and undetectable here

branches.branch: The long-form family pins a 5% business-activity screen with its own prohibited-activity list; this node implements no activity verdict for that family (only the daily-average family activity row is implemented).
The carve-out also excludes compliant instruments from the cash-and-interest-bearing numerator; only the debt-numerator leg is implemented, so the cash numerator stays over-inclusive.
No input field exists to declare preferred-share composition, so the prohibition is unverifiable here.
Trust units are outside the node input schema entirely.
Exemption of Islamic financial institutions from business and financial screening is not modeled; an exempt institution is screened anyway and can be excluded.
The 25%-profile method screens businesses first and finances second; only the financial stage is implemented, so a business-screen failure alone never excludes here.
